test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

SUT5 ∶ PRQ11 ∶∶ DFE8 ∶ ACB14 ∶∶ LNM12 ∶ ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **Alphabets are decreased to 3 positional values.**
 
• **Numbers are added with 6.**

**​****SUT5 becomes PRQ11** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26ef49d2dcf2382b8a1abde1e3696cf4e5e4de1abd18d3bd4d7eb3b722686b94.png] 

**DFE8 becomes ACB14** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/970a897980bcab0431766f01a3a4871841660b465d77ac8c7cd4ea754b36da0c.png] 

Similarly,

**LNM12 becomes IKJ18** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27513a3afbb8a27147fbc09a943f53d2751b047e946728ec70310bd05700bfcd.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
